cards.name: Classic
cards.summary: Bevel profile 'Classic' for Effect > 3D and Materials > 3D (Classic) > Extrude & Bevel (Classic): the cross-section cut into the edge of an extruded object, by its name the standard, basic edge profile of the list. Its profile symbol in Bevels.ai measures about 65 x 11 pt. Not rendered (a script cannot pick a named bevel), so the exact cross-section is unverified.
use_for: plain bevelled 3D headline or logo built with Extrude & Bevel (Classic)
matching older artwork that used the default 3D Classic bevel
avoid: scripted builds: applyEffect's LiveEffect XML takes only scalar values, so this named bevel cannot be set by script; a person has to pick it in the dialog (or reuse a graphic style that already carries it)
new 3D work: Effect > 3D and Materials (the non-Classic 3D) gives better lighting and materials; keep 3D Classic for matching legacy art
artwork without Extrude & Bevel (Classic): the bevel is a setting inside that effect, so it does nothing on its own
cards.applies_to: a path, compound path or text object with Effect > 3D and Materials > 3D (Classic) > Extrude & Bevel (Classic) applied; the bevel shapes the edge of the 3D object
cards.how_to_apply: Select the object, Effect > 3D and Materials > 3D (Classic) > Extrude & Bevel (Classic), choose 'Classic' in the Bevel menu and set its height. No script route: the profile lives as a symbol in C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe Illustrator 2026/Support Files/Required/Resources/en_US/Bevels.ai and applyEffect cannot reference it.

verified.note: Sheet marks it not visual: applyEffect's LiveEffect XML takes only scalar values, so a named bevel cannot be scripted, and Bevels.ai has no PDF content to preview; the summary already flags the profile as unverified.

review.changes: avoid: dropped the unverified 'shows nothing without extrude depth' claim, now says the bevel only acts inside Extrude & Bevel (Classic); applies_to: dropped the unverified extrude-depth requirement

cards.name: Arrow 2.01
cards.summary: Art brush from the Arrows_Special library. Classic archery arrow: a medium-weight solid black shaft, a solid black notched fletching block at the tail and a small solid black barbed head. (Thumbnail: the brush applied by script to a 300 pt S-curve with a 1 pt stroke.)
use_for: curved callout pointing at a product feature
avoid: a very thin, delicate line: Arrow 2.03 is the lighter version
very short or hairpin paths: an art brush stretches its whole arrow along the path, so heads and fletching distort on tight bends
cards.applies_to: a stroked path item (open paths read best); an Art brush (Adobe ArtOnPath Brush Tool / Art Brush Plugin) that stretches the arrow art along the whole path, its width following the stroke weight. The brush must exist in the target document.
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Brush Libraries > Arrows > Arrows_Special, select a path, click 'Arrow 2.01'. Script: app.open("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe Illustrator 2026/Presets/en_US/Brushes/Arrows/Arrows_Special.ai"), doc.brushes.getByName("Arrow 2.01").applyTo(pathItem) on a path in that document, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the brush arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Medium black shaft, solid notched black fletching block at the tail, small solid barbed head.
